native_repairs.cause: BlurPass helper was a second attachment LOAD path with no destination access dependency, independent of the common RenderPass helper.
native_repairs.fix: Color-attachment read/write dependencies on blur attachment begin; color-output writes become fragment shader reads on finish, with matching input/restoration caller scopes.

native_repairs.cause: Output reconfiguration destroyed old framebuffer descriptors before the GPU had finished the preceding frame.
native_repairs.fix: Wait for the Vulkan device before replacing monitor resources on mode/format/size changes. No per-frame wait added.

cleanup: Control client closed; live owned session handed to parent for full matrix/input/lifecycle and final graceful-exit verification.
